body.intent: Fix Agents in runs hit Claude Code permission prompts despite bypassPermissions when recording findings: the build, review and plan-review guides show 'rhiza run findings <file>', so agents write mktemp-and-echo one-liners that Claude Code's shell parser flags ('Dangerous rm operation not ruled out'), stalling the session up to 2 minutes until the prompt auto-blocks (seen 2026-11-05 in run 01M6MJW2 verifier and model check). The guides should show the stdin form ('rhiza run findings --check X - <<EOF') so no temp file or compound shell is needed.
